sent_to_model:
Need help replying in my college group. Rohan is asking about the layoffs and the 3 lakh he put in FixKaro, his wife is also asking him. Its a fair question yaar, I owe him a straight answer, but this is the group so I dont want to make it a funeral also. Want it funny but honest, no fake "we are crushing it" types. He should not panic but I am not going to promise his money is safe because I genuinely dont know. Thread is below, notes also

- let go 6 of 14 people last friday, gave everyone 2 months pay and helped 4 of them get interviews already
- bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct, term sheet was basically ready
- runway now about 5 months after the cuts
- app has around 41k monthly users, plumbers and electricians side is growing, AC servicing side is bleeding money
- plan is shut AC servicing, focus on housing society tie-ups, 3 societies in HSR already signed pilots
- Rohan and Divya put 3 lakh in the friends round in 2025, same terms as everyone else
- the VC partner said "we love the energy" on the call and then stopped replying for 11 days
- eating Maggi at office at 11pm so often the security uncle now asks if I want masala or plain
- amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring
- firing people was the worst day of my life, worse than failing maths in 2nd sem
- honestly I think we have a real shot with the societies but its not a sure thing
- Rohan has every right to ask, he trusted me with real money
- tell Rohan straight what happened and where it stands, money is at risk but not gone
- offer to call him and Divya properly this week, will show the numbers
- keep the group laughing, I am fine, coming saturday and Pranav is buying
